requirement: Speed up and isolate Playwright tests by aborting image, font and media requests and any request to a host outside an allow list, while letting first-party traffic through.
skeleton: A blocked resource type set and a RequestBlocker validating a lowercase allow list, matching hosts and subdomains, and a handle method that aborts and returns or continues, plus reset.
caption: A Playwright page.route handler, written in the standard library against duck-typed route and request objects with no third-party imports, that speeds up tests by blocking heavy and third-party requests. BLOCKED_TYPES holds image, font and media. RequestBlocker(allowed_hosts) lowercases the hosts, raises ValueError when none are given, and records blocked URLs. A host is allowed when it equals an allowed host or ends with a dot followed by one. handle(route) takes the request's hostname from urllib.parse.urlsplit, which drops the port and lowercases it, and when the resource type is blocked or the host is not allowed it records the URL, calls route.abort() and returns; otherwise it calls route.continue_(). reset clears the record. The fixture asserts that first-party documents and subdomains continue, port and case handling, aborted heavy types, aborted third-party and lookalike hosts, and the empty allow list.

plan.intent: Keep end-to-end tests fast and offline from trackers
constraints: An empty allow list raises ValueError
Hosts are parsed with urlsplit hostname, ignoring port and case
Subdomains match only after a dot
Image, font and media requests are aborted
Each route is either aborted or continued, never both

rationale.teaches: Parse hostname with urlsplit, match exact hosts or dot-prefixed suffixes, and handle each route exactly once by returning after abort.
rationale.why: A bare suffix match lets lookalike domains through, netloc keeps ports and breaks matching, and calling continue after abort raises inside Playwright's route handling.

ops.docstring: A Playwright page.route handler that blocks heavy and third-party requests.

candidates.why_wrong: A lookalike host such as badexample.com passes the allow list.
netloc keeps the port and case, so first-party requests are blocked.
A blocked route is aborted and then continued as well.
Font downloads are not blocked and slow every page load.
An empty allow list is accepted and silently blocks every request.
